messages.subject: Error in geno_names(cross$crosstype, alleles, cross$is_x_chr[chr]) :
parts:
Hi,

I encountered a problem while trying to calculate geno_prob. I have a backcross data. Control file has the following format,

#Male parent
crosstype: bc
geno: Riparia_geno.csv
pheno: pheno.csv
gmap: Riparia_gmap.csv
alleles:
- n
- p
genotypes:
  nn: 1
  np: 2
na.strings:
- '--'
- NA

I have all the files mentioned in the control file in the same directory. I read the data in R.
#Read input files
Male<-read_cross2("G:/RQTL2/Mydata/Riparia.yaml",quiet = TRUE)
#Insert pseudo markers
map<-insert_pseudomarkers(Male$gmap,step = 1)
#Calculate geno_prob
pr<-calc_genoprob(Male,map)

but it shows an error:

Error in geno_names(cross$crosstype, alleles, cross$is_x_chr[chr]) : 
  Expecting a string vector: [type=list; required=STRSXP].

Any help will be highly appreciated.

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Error in geno_names(cross$crosstype, alleles, cross$is_x_chr[chr]) :
parts:
Seems that you need to put quotes around n and p in alleles in your yaml control file.
I'd go ahead and put them around NA in na.strings, too:

#Male parent
crosstype: bc
geno: Riparia_geno.csv
pheno: pheno.csv
gmap: Riparia_gmap.csv
alleles:
- 'n'
- 'p'
genotypes:
nn: 1
np: 2
na.strings:
- '--'

karl
